title: External deployment mode: co-located tickets, remote repo sync, offline cache
objective: Support co-located tickets in the same repo as code and dedicated remote ticket repos with git-based sync and offline-first operation with conflict resolution.

acceptance_criteria.text: Co-located tickets in the same repo as code are supported.
A dedicated remote ticket repo can be synced with git.
Offline-first operation works with documented conflict resolution.

needed: routing-mode tests for co-located and remote stores
